queries.sql: SELECT t1.tx_id FROM txs t1 JOIN txs t2 ON t2.from_account = t1.to_account AND t2.ts >= t1.ts JOIN txs t3 ON t3.from_account = t2.to_account AND t3.ts >= t2.ts AND t3.to_account = t1.from_account WHERE t1.from_account <> t1.to_account AND t1.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2022-09-08 16:12:00' LIMIT 10000

conditions.condition: payment 2 starts where payment 1 ended, later in time
payment 3 sends the money back to the account that made payment 1
conditions.from_indicator: ultimately revert to the same origin
